lines.en: label springtime8:
scene gettingreadyxmas1
: Maybe...to the left a little more?
lines.zh: : 也许……再往左一点？

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas2
: The {i}left?!{/i} Didn’t ya just tell me to move it to the right a second ago?! Girl-Sensei, get your butt over here and teach Futaba directions before my arms friggin’ fall off!
lines.zh: : 往左？！你刚刚不是才让我往右挪吗？！女老师，你给我滚过来教教 Futaba 什么叫方向，不然老娘的手臂要掉下来了！

lines.en: : The nerve of this boob-woman, makin’ the short girl handle the friggin’ circular Christmas tree things while she stands over there and looks all...boobalicious.
lines.zh: : 这个奶霸倒是好意思，让矮个子姑娘扛那些圆形的圣诞树玩意儿，自己站在那儿一副……波涛汹涌的样子。

lines.en: : They’re called “wreaths,” Miku. And I’m sorry for making you do all the heavy lifting. But you see, my back is just very sore from being so “boobalicious” all the time.
lines.zh: : 那叫「花环」，Miku。抱歉让你干所有重活。可你要知道，我的背因为一直这么「波涛汹涌」而特别酸痛。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas3
: Yeah, save the friggin’ sob story for when we’re runnin’ from zombies or I ain’t gonna stop to help you up. Friggin’ {i}wreaths.{/i} I obviously know what a “wreath” is.
lines.zh: : 行啊，把你那该死的苦情戏留到我们被僵尸追的时候再演，不然我可不会停下来扶你。该死的{i}花环{/i}。我当然知道「花环」是什么。

lines.en: : Is it really just us four this time? Don’t we normally have a few more people decorating with us?
lines.zh: : 这次真的只有我们四个吗？平时不是还有几个人跟我们一起布置吗？

lines.en: : Yeah well, when half the class is absent all the time now and the guy that everybody only comes to these parties to see is MIA, this is what you get.
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在一半的同学老是缺席，而大家来这些派对唯一想见的那家伙又失踪了，结果就是这样。

lines.en: : I’m sure a few more of the girls will show up soon. You said Ayane was coming, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我相信很快还会有几个女生来的。你说 Ayane 会来，是吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. And I’m pretty sure she’s bringing Sana as well. But, like Miku, there is a limit to what she’ll be able to accomplish.
lines.zh: : 嗯。而且我挺确定她会带上 Sana。不过跟 Miku 一样，她能办到的事也有限。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas4
: Y’all are sure talkin’ a lotta smack for a couple girls who ain’t doin’ crap!
lines.zh: : 你们两个啥也不干，倒是挺能说大话的！

lines.en: : Half of this heckin’ room’s been made up by Miku! And just because I ain’t got a career path laid out like you brainiacs don’t mean I’m gonna become a friggin’ interior designer!
lines.zh: : 这破房间有一半都是 Miku 布置的！别因为我没像你们这群书呆子那样规划好职业道路，就以为我该去当什么室内设计师！

lines.en: : But you’re so good at it. You know right from left and everything.
lines.zh: : 可你很擅长啊。你还分得清左右什么的。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas5
: Know what? I’m done. You want another {i}wreath{/i} on the wall? Put it up yourself. I’m clockin’ out.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我不干了。你还想在墙上挂个{i}花环{/i}？自己挂去。我下班了。

lines.en: : Thanks for all your help, Miku. We couldn’t have done it without you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的帮忙，Miku。没有你我们可做不到。

lines.en: : Oh, I know. But still...you’re welcome, I guess. But I’m only sayin’ that cause it’s Christmas. Got it?
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。不过还是……不客气吧。我只因为今天是圣诞节才这么说的。明白吗？

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : Aren’t we missing something? I keep feeling like something is missing.
lines.zh: : 我们是不是少了点什么？我总觉得少了点什么。

lines.en: : We {i}are{/i} missing something. It’s about six feet tall and has questionable sexual preferences.
lines.zh: : 我们确实少了点什么。大概六英尺高，而且性取向存疑。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas6
: Frosty the Snowman?
lines.zh: : 雪人 Frosty？

lines.en: : Makoto...you really shouldn’t badmouth someone who isn’t here to defend himself. Even if...there’s no sign pointing to when he {i}will{/i} be here to do that.
lines.zh: : Makoto……你真不该说一个不在场、没法为自己辩护的人的坏话。哪怕……没有任何迹象表明他什么时候才会到场为自己辩护。

lines.en: : It’s gotta be Frosty, right? Because there ain’t no way Santa Claus has “questionable sexual preferences” when the only people he hangs out with are rein-
lines.zh: : 那肯定是 Frosty，对吧？因为圣诞老人不可能「性取向存疑」，他唯一混在一起的伙伴就是驯——

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas7
: Oh my God! That jolly old guy’s porkin’ deer, ain’t he?! Nobody tell Uta!
lines.zh: : 我的天！那个快活的老头在操鹿，是不是？！谁都别告诉 Uta！

lines.en: : Miku...sometimes, I can’t help but wonder how you even learned to tie your shoes.
lines.zh: : Miku……有时候我真忍不住好奇，你到底是怎么学会系鞋带的。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas8

: This is the twentieth century, Futaba. Nobody ties their shoes anymore. You tie ‘em once really tight and you’re set for life. Just gotta wiggle ‘em around a little bit to make ‘em fit. Like a wiener.
lines.zh: : 这可是二十世纪啊，Futaba。现在没人系鞋带了。你一次系得特别紧，就能用一辈子。只要稍微扭一扭就能套进去。就像香肠一样。

lines.en: : That...isn’t really...actually, okay. You win.
lines.zh: : 那……算不上……其实算了。你赢了。

lines.en: : Man, bitches be fuckin’ crazy nowadays. If I talked about wieners around {i}my{/i} family at your age, I’d be going to bed hungry as shit.
lines.zh: : 天啊，现在的丫头们真是疯得可以。我像你们这么大的时候要敢在家里聊香肠，早就饿着肚子去睡觉了。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas9
: That’s funny because I think I’d be rewarded with extra dessert for doing the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 真好笑，因为我觉得我要是做同样的事，会被奖励额外的甜点。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like the two of you ain’t ever heard about sausage-Sundays. At my house, every weekend was-
lines.zh: : 听起来你们俩从没听说过「香肠星期天」。在我家，每个周末都是——

lines.en: : Oh look, another wreath to put up.
lines.zh: : 哦看，又一个花环要挂。

lines.en: : Don’t you heckin’ look at me, Futaba. I ain’t kiddin’ this time.
lines.zh: : 别他妈看我，Futaba。这次我可没在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Was your family...religious or something, Imani?
lines.zh: : 你家……信教什么的吗，Imani？

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas10
: My dad was a pastor, but he wasn’t ever really {i}weird{/i} about it. Just a little...traditional.
lines.zh: : 我爸是个牧师，不过他在这方面从来不算怪。只是有点……传统。

lines.en: : He dragged all of us to mass on Christmas and Easter and whatnot so we couldn’t ever celebrate with the other, like...ten kids that celebrated those things in our neighborhood.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节和复活节什么的，他把我们全拖去做弥撒，害我们不能跟街坊里另外那……十个也过这些节的孩子一起庆祝。

lines.en: : {i}All of us?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们全都在内？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m the youngest of seven.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我是七个孩子里最小的。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas11
: Jesus.
lines.zh: : 天啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个意思。

lines.en: : You know what Jesus says about making babies — “Pop ‘em out until you can’t afford any more.”
lines.zh: : 你知道耶稣怎么谈论生孩子吗——「一直生，生到养不起为止。」

lines.en: scene black
scene jesuswasreal
scene black
scene gettingreadyxmas12
: Now, I ain’t no expert-
lines.zh: : 我可不是什么专家——

lines.en: : Actual Jesus quotes aside, where the fuck’s Rin at? Shouldn’t {i}she{/i} be helping us too since she ain’t got a girlfriend to worry about anymore?
lines.zh: : 撇开耶稣原话不谈，Rin 到底跑哪儿去了？既然{i}她{/i}现在没女朋友要操心了，不是也该来帮忙吗？

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas13
: Rin’s with her mom right now. She’s going through a bit of a...crisis.
lines.zh: : Rin 现在跟她妈妈在一起。她正在经历一点……危机。

lines.en: : Damn, and she thinks {i}Rika’s{/i} gonna help? Poor girl. Bitch is gonna come back with a pixie cut and a tramp stamp of Otoha’s name all crossed out or something.
lines.zh: : 靠，她以为 Rika 能帮上忙？可怜的姑娘。那婊子回来的时候大概会顶个精灵短发，后腰上纹个 Otoha 的名字再打个大叉什么的。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas14
: It won’t be {i}that{/i} bad. I know it feels longer, but the two of them only dated for a few months.
lines.zh: : 不会那么糟的。我知道感觉上更久，可她们俩只交往了几个月。

lines.en: : Or was it {i}actually{/i} several years but no one can remember it because of-
lines.zh: : 还是说其实是好几年，只是没人记得，因为——

lines.en: : Plus, Rin’s actually been taking it surprisingly well. She hasn’t cried at all since the first week.
lines.zh: : 而且 Rin 其实接受得意外地好。从第一周之后她就没哭过。

lines.en: : Wow. That never stops being weird.
lines.zh: : 哇。这事永远都那么诡异。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ve been thinkin’ that Rin’s been kinda mature about the whole breakup thingy. Specially since she ain’t really mature about anything ever. Least not anything involvin’ girls.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也觉得 Rin 对分手这整件事挺成熟的。尤其是什么事她都不成熟，至少涉及女生的事都不。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas15
: She...does have a rather entertaining track record in that category, yes.
lines.zh: : 她……在那方面确实有一份相当「精彩」的履历，没错。

lines.en: : But hey! Now she can start comin’ after Sensei like the rest of us! I always thought those two would make a cute couple.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿！现在她可以跟我们其他人一样来追 Sensei 了！我一直觉得他俩挺般配的。

lines.en: : Yeah, they’ll be totally adorable locked in Senpai’s house where no one will ever see them again.
lines.zh: : 是啊，他们被锁在 Senpai 的屋子里、再也见不到任何人，那画面一定可爱极了。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas16
: You really {i}are{/i} taking this poorly, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你这件事真的看得很不开啊，是吧？

lines.en: : {i}Me?{/i} Noooooo! I’m totally fine! I {i}love{/i} losing contact with my best friend and I’m not even {i}remotely{/i} pissed that I received no form of closure or even an explanation about {i}why!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我？才没有！我好得很！我超爱跟我最好的朋友失联的，我也一点都不生气——连一句交代、一句{i}为什么{/i}都没给我！

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas17
: You see, that sort of thing is {i}totally{/i} normal for adults! And when you girls are all grown up, I’m sure you’ll experience the same thing time and time again! Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 你瞧，这种事对成年人来说完全正常！等你们这些丫头长大了，肯定会一次又一次地经历同样的事！哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Is it just me or has Imani been gettin’ kinda scary lately?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的错觉，还是 Imani 最近变得有点吓人？

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas18
: Me?! {i}Scary?!{/i} Hahaha! I could never!
lines.zh: : 我？！{i}吓人{/i}？！哈哈哈！我怎么会！

lines.en: : But I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t {i}extremely{/i} excited to smack my beloved Senpai upside his {b}STUPID{/b} fucking head whenever he comes out of hiding! Hahahaha!
lines.zh: : 不过要说我不极度期待在我亲爱的 Senpai 从藏身处钻出来时，狠狠扇他那颗愚蠢的脑袋，那我就是在撒谎！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : You know...maybe we should take a little break from decorating until some of the other girls show up?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……也许我们该暂停布置，等其他女生来了再说？

lines.en: : Boobzilla, can’t ya give incest girl a call or somethin’? Maybe she can take a break from watchin’ weird porn videos to come learn about wreaths and Jesus.
lines.zh: : 奶霸，你就不能给那个乱伦妹打个电话什么的？说不定她能从看奇怪色情片的空当里抽出身，来学学花环和耶稣。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas19
: I can try, but...
lines.zh: : 我可以试试，不过……

lines.en: : Nodoka hasn’t really been...{i}present{/i} lately...
lines.zh: : Nodoka 最近一直不太……在状态……

lines.en: : You good, yo? I’m getting dressed over here and you haven’t even made one weird comment about my body.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，喂？我在这儿换衣服，你居然一句关于我身体的怪话都没说。

lines.en: : You see one teenage girl naked, you’ve seen them {i}all{/i} naked.
lines.zh: : 你见过一个十几岁女孩的裸体，就等于见过所有的了。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas20
: Christ, it’s even worse than I thought.
lines.zh: : 天啊，比我想的还糟。

lines.en: : The hell happened? You were fine just yesterday. Thought you were finally done with your seemingly endless death march to finish your latest {i}masterpiece.{/i}
lines.zh: : 到底怎么回事？你昨天还好好的。我以为你终于结束了那场没完没了的行军，写完了你最新的{i}杰作{/i}。

lines.en: : I was fine because I am a paragon of self-control and mental stability and can make people believe anything I want them to believe.
lines.zh: : 我没事，因为我是自控力与精神稳定的典范，能让人们相信任何我想让他们相信的东西。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas19
: Then, if you’re a paragon of mental stability, how come you strip down to your underwear and start tossing mugs around the room at least once per week?
lines.zh: : 那既然你是精神稳定的典范，为什么你每周至少要脱到只剩内衣、在房间里乱扔杯子一次？

lines.en: : That isn’t me. It’s my evil twin, Shiori.
lines.zh: : 那不是我。是我的邪恶双胞胎 Shiori 干的。

lines.en: : So what? You’re just gonna...lay there writing and not bother celebrating Christmas this year?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你就打算……躺在那儿写东西，今年连圣诞节都不过了？

lines.en: : Are you so lonely without your now {i}ex-{/i}girlfriend that {i}I{/i} get to be your Christmas date this year?
lines.zh: : 你是没了你的{i}前{/i}女友寂寞到非得让{i}我{/i}当你今年的圣诞约会对象吗？

lines.en: : You? Absolutely not. You’re probably the last person I would ever consider dating. I just want to know if I’m going to be walking to the party alone or not. And also if I should call an ambulance.
lines.zh: : 你？绝对不行。你大概是我最不可能考虑约会的人。我只是想知道，我要不要一个人走到派对现场，还有我要不要叫救护车。

lines.en: : I’m still going to the party. But don’t expect me to don some extravagant dress as I am extremely busy and on the verge of a breakthrough right now.
lines.zh: : 我还是会去派对的。不过别指望我会穿上什么华丽的裙子，因为我非常忙，而且正处在突破的边缘。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas21
: Oooh, a breakthrough? Which one of our friends got laid this time and how are you going to spice it up for your readers?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，突破？这次是我们哪个朋友上床了，你打算怎么给读者加点料？

lines.en: : I haven’t touched that series in over a month. I’m working on something else right now.
lines.zh: : 我已经一个多月没碰那个系列了。我现在在忙别的东西。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas19
: You are? How come I didn’t know about this?
lines.zh: : 是吗？我怎么不知道？

lines.en: : Because you’ve been too busy shattering the hearts of local lesbians into a trillion pieces and chasing after a woman who will never love you no matter how hard you try to make her.
lines.zh: : 因为你一直忙着把本地蕾丝边的心碎成一万亿片，还忙着追一个无论你怎么努力都不会爱你的女人。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas22
: I’m focusing on my {i}music,{/i} Nodoka. And I don’t remember ever confessing my feelings for {i}anyone{/i} to you, so I have no idea what you’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : 我在专心搞我的音乐，Nodoka。而且我不记得跟你表白过对任何人的感情，所以我现在完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. You’re a lone wolf who feasts on the carcases of weaker beings and I am but an oblivious little fly on the wall of your cerebral cortex.
lines.zh: : 对对对。你是一匹以弱者尸体为食的孤狼，而我不过是你大脑皮层墙上一只浑然不觉的小苍蝇。

lines.en: : A pain in the ass is what you really are.
lines.zh: : 你真正的身份就是个讨厌鬼。

lines.en: : Silence, destroyer of hearts. You’re disrupting my train of thought, and I have not once attempted to drag my over-sized luggage onto {i}yours.{/i}
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，心的毁灭者。你在打断我的思路，而我可从没试图把我那超大号行李拖到你的思路上去。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas23
: You’re right. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。抱歉。

lines.en: : You always leave me alone when I’m in the zone, so...I’ll stay out of yours if you need me to. Just wanted to make sure you weren’t like, writing your suicide note or something.
lines.zh: : 我进入状态的时候你总是让我一个人待着，所以……如果你需要，我也会不打扰你。只是想确认一下你不是在写遗书之类的。

lines.en: : I can’t die. I have too much left to discover. Too much left to {i}learn.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不能死。我还有太多东西没发现。还有太多东西要学。

lines.en: : You, uhh...branching out to mystery novels now?
lines.zh: : 你，呃……现在开始涉足推理小说了？

lines.en: : What I’m doing now is closer to {i}solving{/i} them. S.A. Nagahara is on a temporary hiatus while I attempt to piece together how and {i}why{/i} we are where we are right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在做的更接近{i}解{/i}谜。S.A. Nagahara 暂时停摆，而我在试着拼凑出我们如今何以、又为何走到了这一步。

lines.en: : As in you’re, like...trying to figure out the meaning of life? Or will you finally be the one to discover why there are so many empty floors in this building?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你就像……在试图弄明白生命的意义？还是说你终于要去发现这栋楼为什么有那么多空楼层？

lines.en: : Nothing so vague as your first suggestion, but the second {i}does{/i} pique my interest. Regardless, I have a much simpler question to both ask and answer.
lines.zh: : 没你第一个建议那么笼统，不过第二个确实激起了我的兴趣。总之，我有一个简单得多的问题要问，也要回答。

lines.en: : Who {i}is{/i} Akira Arakawa exactly?
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa 究竟是谁？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : My instinct was to reply with “the one and only” but it would partially contradict what I’ve written down thus far. So take this response as me verbally nodding.
lines.zh: : 我本能想回一句「独一无二的那位」，可那会跟我迄今写下的内容部分矛盾。所以就把这个回答当成我在口头点头吧。

lines.en: : You could have just said “yes” but you do you, I guess. Either way, is {i}all{/i} of this for him? Like...is {i}that{/i} the question you’ve been stuck on for over a month now?
lines.zh: : 你直接说「是」就行了，不过随你便吧。话说回来，这一切都是为了他吗？就像……这就是你卡了一个多月的问题？

lines.en: : It isn’t {i}for{/i} him, it is {i}about{/i} him. And the reason I’m so hopelessly stuck on such a simple question is that every answer I come up with just gives me {i}more{/i} questions.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}为了{/i}他，是{i}关于{/i}他。而我在这么简单的问题上死死卡住，是因为我想出的每一个答案只会给我带来更多的问题。

lines.en: : If only we could, like...actually talk to him. That would make shit way easier than whatever sort of mental journey you’re taking right now to straight up manifest his personal details.
lines.zh: : 要是我们能……真的跟他谈谈就好了。那样事情会比你此刻在脑子里折腾、凭空推断他的个人信息要容易得多。

lines.en: : Strangely enough, I’m not sure if it would. As in, I don’t think there is anything he could tell me that would answer my question the way I {i}want{/i} it to be answered.
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，我不确定那样是否有用。也就是说，我不觉得他能说出任何能以我{i}想{/i}要的方式回答我这个问题的话。

lines.en: : However, there is a certain red-haired niece of his that I would {i}love{/i} to pick the brain of, if that brain would only emerge from its shell every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 不过，他那位红头发的侄女，我倒是很想撬开她的脑子看看——如果那个脑子肯偶尔从壳里探出头来的话。

lines.en: : Ami? Yeah, I’m pretty sure her “shell” is just empty. I can’t imagine {i}her{/i} having whatever sort of groundbreaking information you’re looking for, even {i}if{/i} it’s about Sensei.
lines.zh: : Ami？是啊，我挺确定她的「壳」里是空的。我想象不出{i}她{/i}会掌握你正在找的那种突破性的信息，哪怕是关于 Sensei 的。

lines.en: : And that is where I think you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 而我认为你错就错在这里。

lines.en: : You see, Ami Arakawa is special. But not everyone realizes that just yet.
lines.zh: : 你瞧，Ami Arakawa 是特别的。只是还没有所有人意识到这一点。

lines.en: : Special? Are we really talking about the same person right now?
lines.zh: : 特别？我们现在说的是同一个人吗？

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas24
: It is precisely that reaction that reaffirms my current line of thinking — that she’s nothing short of a marsh warbler. A facade. That she’s had you all in the palms of her hands this entire time.
lines.zh: : 正是这种反应印证了我目前的思路——她完完全全就是一只湿地苇莺。一层伪装。她一直把你们所有人攥在掌心。

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : Do you know who her mother is, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你知道她母亲是谁吗，Otoha？

lines.en: : I...know that she’s dead? How many Nodoka points does that earn me?
lines.zh: : 我……只知道她死了？这能给我加多少 Nodoka 积分？

lines.en: : Ami Arakawa is the daughter of the Girl Who Cannot Breathe.
lines.zh: : Ami Arakawa 是那个「无法呼吸的女孩」的女儿。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m an idiot for not piecing it together sooner. I have no idea how it slipped by me so easily. But now that I’m actually {i}thinking{/i} about it, everything fits. It {i}all{/i} fucking fits.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我真是蠢，没早点把它拼起来。我不知道它怎么就这么轻易地从我眼皮底下溜过去了。可现在我真的开始思考了，一切都对得上。全都他妈对得上。

lines.en: : I don’t know who-
lines.zh: : 我不知道谁——

lines.en: : Don’t lie to me, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 别对我撒谎，Otoha。

lines.en: : I know you, so I {i}know{/i} you know.
lines.zh: : 我了解你，所以我{i}知道{/i}你知道。

lines.en: : But it isn’t just that piece of information that has me surrounded by crumpled up sheets of paper on the bed. The reason for {i}that{/i} is much harder to explain.
lines.zh: : 不过让我床上堆满揉皱的纸的，不止那一条信息。那背后的原因要难解释得多。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve {i}really{/i} gotta finish getting ready for the party now. So just...go ahead and do your own thing and we can talk, like...later. Or something.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我现在真得把派对的准备做完了。所以……你继续忙你的，我们改天再聊。或者什么的。

lines.en: : Are you sure? I’ve yet to even clue you in on what my impending {i}breakthrough{/i} is. Don’t tell me you’re no longer interested?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？我还没让你知道我即将迎来的{i}突破{/i}是什么呢。别告诉我你没兴趣了？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m...I’m good. You can tell me some other time.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我没事。你改天再告诉我也行。

lines.en: scene gettingreadyxmas25
: Boooo. You disrupt my work just to hand me a new time-card? How dull and predictable of you.
lines.zh: : 嘘——。你打断我的工作，就为了塞给我一张新的时间表？真是又无聊又老套。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you this though, my friend. If I am {i}right...{/i}which I typically am...
lines.zh: : 不过有一点我可以向你保证，我的朋友。如果我是对的——而我通常都是对的……

lines.en: : You’re going to think I’m even {i}more{/i} insane than you already do.
lines.zh: : 你会觉得我比你原本以为的还要疯。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ll wait and see if that’s even possible, because I’m pretty sure it’s not.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我倒要看看这有没有可能，因为我挺确定是不可能的。

lines.en: : Oh well. At least I can take solace in the fact that I’m not alone in my efforts. Because right now, there’s at least {i}one{/i} other person getting just as excited as me about all this.
lines.zh: : 算了。至少我能从一件事上得到安慰——我的努力并不孤单。因为现在，至少还有一个人跟我一样对这一切感到兴奋。

lines.en: : What? Who? And how do you even know that?
lines.zh: : 什么？谁？你是怎么知道的？
